slide: 14 · The study – A Mediterranean case study

headline: Skilful in years the model never saw
bullets: Test AUC 0.78–0.90 at 9 of 12 sites, above a trend-only model
F1 twice that of always predicting a heatwave (0.38 vs 0.19)

headline: Detects most heatwave days
bullets: At a price: false alarms (Libya 175, Croatia 203)

headline: Warm air over the site and a Z500 ridge over or next to it
bullets: Tmax confirmed at 8 sites, mostly over the site
Z500 ridges at 6 sites, often next to the site
Alps–Balkans ridge shared by Monaco, Croatia, Albania, Greece and Algeria

headline: Warmer seas before heatwaves
bullets: Warmer Mediterranean before heatwaves at 6 sites (1950–2010)
Confirmed out of sample at Greece (Black Sea, 4–10 days)
Atlantic and tropical SST: year-to-year signal (Turkey)

headline: Most precursors act 3–20 days ahead
bullets: Tmax and Z500 ridge: 3–20 days (3 d = shortest lag allowed)
Soil moisture and MSLP: up to 3 weeks, at few sites
Remote SST: 6–10 weeks, but only as a year-to-year signal
